added.summary: {#key expr} makes its content again (new elements, their entrances playing) when expr changes; {@const name = expr} names an expression inside a block; {#await $load}…{:then value}…{:catch error}…{/await} shows its branches by the settled record a store holds ({ status: "pending" | "fulfilled" | "rejected", value, reason }). Nothing is awaited in the tick (docs/ui.md §2).

A document's <script lang="ts"> may declare its props with literal defaults (let { gold = 0 } = $props()) and name pure expressions with $derived(expr) or $derived.by(() => expr); a component user who leaves a prop out reads its default, and the generated .d.ts marks it optional. $state, $effect, imports, functions and other statements are refused with a diagnostic pointing to a TS system.

added.member: UI documents: transition:, in:, out: and animate:flip
added.summary: Svelte's fade, fly, slide, scale and blur with their duration, delay, easing (svelte/easing's names) and own params map onto the element's enter and exit presence, crossfade's key onto its shared-element key, and animate:flip onto its layout motion. Presentation only.

added.member: UI documents: style:prop={value}, style:prop|important and style="…"
added.summary: An element's own declarations for any supported property, bound or literal; they win over every stylesheet rule but an !important one, and |important wins over that too.

bind:this={name} names the element (its id; the name reads as that id, for popovertarget, anchorTo and #name selectors). use:name={params} sends DocEvents of kind "use" with value { phase: "create" | "update" | "destroy", params } when the element is made, its params change and it goes, for the game's handler.

<svelte:window onresize={action} bind:innerWidth={w} bind:innerHeight={h}/> sends an event when the screen's size changes and names its size; <svelte:element this={tag}> is that tag, or for a bound tag the text or block tag it names. The $ui store gains width and height. <svelte:document>, <svelte:boundary> and the Svelte 4 elements are refused with the reason.
